bug_semantics: LiquidJS documents `root` as the directory (or list of directories) against which `renderFile()` / `parseFile()` filenames are resolved, but top-level loads use `LookupType.Root` and skip the containment check applied to `{% include %}` / `{% render %}` / `{% layout %}`. At v10.25.4, `Parser._parseFile` (`src/parser/parser.ts:88-89`) defaults to `LookupType.Root` and calls `loader.lookup`. `Loader.lookup` (`src/fs/loader.ts:46-54`) sets `const enforceRoot = type !== LookupType.Root` and only runs `fs.contains` when `enforceRoot` is true. `candidates()` still yields `fs.resolve(dir, file, extname)` and optional `fs.fallback(file)`; Node `path.resolve` ignores `dir` when `file` is absolute, so `renderFile('/etc/hosts')` with `root` pointing at an unrelated temp directory returns `/etc/hosts` if the process can read it. Impact is arbitrary local file disclosure (CWE-22) for apps that treat `root` as a sandbox and forward attacker-controlled template names into those APIs.
flaw_origin: The skip is an explicit Root exemption first written on 2021-10-06 in 822ba0be0f1cfbedd50376aff8ac49eee71bd48c (`fix: skip root check for renderFile()`). Its parent a3455ebd0b207141c34630c0af44d917db2ca1dd had just added `referenced.startsWith(dir)` containment for every lookup type, which would reject `path.resolve(root, '/etc/hosts') === '/etc/hosts'`. 822ba0b changed `lookup` to call `this.candidates(..., type !== LookupType.Root)` and gated the prefix check with `if (!enforceRoot || referenced.startsWith(dir))`, restoring absolute-path `renderFile()` while leaving include/render/layout constrained. `git log -S 'type !== LookupType.Root' -- src/fs/loader.ts` shows that exact expression was added only in 822ba0b and removed only in the 2026 patch; later #855 (CVE-2026-30952 fallback `contains`) and #867 (move the check from `candidates` into `lookup`) reused or relocated the same Root skip rather than introducing it.

PoC and mechanism match GHSA: Liquid({root:[tempdir]}).renderFile('/etc/hosts') succeeds because LookupType.Root skips contains(). v10.25.4 src/parser/parser.ts:88-89 `_parseFile` -> loader.lookup(..., LookupType.Root); src/fs/loader.ts:46 `const enforceRoot = type !== LookupType.Root` then 47-54 skip contains when false; candidates() 67-74 still yield path.resolve and fallback.

BIC 822ba0be0f1cfbedd50376aff8ac49eee71bd48c (2021-10-06, Harttle <yangjvn@126.com>, subject 'fix: skip root check for renderFile()'): single parent a3455ebd0b207141c34630c0af44d917db2ca1dd; not a merge/squash. Diff introduces `this.candidates(file, dirs, currentFile, type !== LookupType.Root)` and `if (!enforceRoot || referenced.startsWith(dir))`.

Parent verification: `git grep 'type !== LookupType.Root' a3455ebd0b207141c34630c0af44d917db2ca1dd -- '*.ts'` empty. Parent src/fs/loader.ts:52-56 required `referenced.startsWith(dir)` for every candidate including Root, so `/etc/hosts` against a non-prefix root would not be yielded (Node fallback is require.resolve, which does not resolve `/etc/hosts`).

Lineage: `git log -S 'type !== LookupType.Root' -- src/fs/loader.ts` = 822ba0b (add) and f41c1fc (remove) only. 3cd024d652dc883c46307581e979fe32302adbac (#855, in v10.25.0) kept passing `type !== LookupType.Root` as enforceRoot. 529dd67eeb6b125637623d6a723601f0938d3613 (#867, in v10.25.3) relocated it to `const enforceRoot = type !== LookupType.Root` in lookup(); that is a refactor, not a first-write BIC. Cursor trailers on #867/#870 are later/fix-only and do not attribute 822ba0b.

reasoning: The advisory is a real CWE-22, not a withdrawn/rejected CVE. Top-level `renderFile`/`parseFile` load through `LookupType.Root`. After a3455eb added prefix containment for all lookup types, 822ba0b explicitly disabled that check for Root so absolute filenames reach `exists()`/`readFile`. Node `path.resolve(root, '/etc/hosts')` returns `/etc/hosts`, which is the PoC. That `type !== LookupType.Root` special-case is the smallest first-write of the surviving vulnerable lines: it is absent on the immediate parent tree, is a tiny non-merge commit, and pickaxe shows it lived until f41c1fc. March 2026 #855 hardened fallback/contains for include/render/layout but reused the Root skip; #867 only moved the same predicate into `lookup`. Those are incomplete later hardenings/refactors, not BICs. 822ba0b is in v9.28.0 through v10.25.4 and not in v9.27.1; f41c1fc lands in v10.25.5, matching GHSA `<=10.25.4` / patched `10.25.5` (CVE.org's 10.25.3 bound is a CNA version error).
